title.en: French consumer sentiment ends this chart about 80
title.zh: 法国消费者信心指数在本图收于约 80。

analysis.en: One orange line plots a consumer-sentiment index. The vertical scale runs from 75 to 105, with a gridline every five points. The horizontal scale runs from 2014 through 2026. The line peaks near the top gridline twice, once late in the 2010s and once near 2021, then drops to the 80 gridline in 2022. It climbs back toward the low 90s around 2024 and then falls, finishing about 80, where a short purple tick marks the last reading. The footnote names the national statistics institute as the source.
analysis.zh: 一条橙色曲线描绘消费者信心指数。纵轴自 75 至 105，每五个点一条网格线。横轴自 2014 年至 2026 年。曲线两次接近顶部网格线，一次在 2010 年代后期，一次在 2021 年附近，随后于 2022 年落到 80 的网格线。2024 年前后回升至 90 出头，然后回落，收在约 80，末点有一短紫色刻度。脚注写明来源为该国统计机构。

title.en: Crude fell again as Gulf talks kept the risk premium on the back foot

fact.en: The December WTI contract fell 1.83% to 99.90 dollars a barrel and the December Brent contract fell 1.67% to 113.88, 华尔街见闻 reported. Oil kept falling as traders weighed signs of a cooler Gulf and waited on the Israeli election, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：WTI 12月合约跌1.83%报99.90美元/桶，布伦特12月合约跌1.67%报113.88美元/桶。 财经早茶：油价继续回落，交易员权衡波斯湾局势降温迹象，并等待以色列大选结果。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: Talks extended the crude drop, and a strike on a Saudi export terminal did not turn the settle around. CICC (30 June): the low-inventory mark left by the Strait shock is hard to erase and can hold a higher floor under oil. Oil carries the 99.90 WTI settle and the 113.88 Brent settle. The theme changes if those talks break and Brent rises back through 113.88.
mechanism.zh: 谈判使原油跌势延续，对沙特出口终端的袭击并未扭转结算价。中金（6月30日）：海峡冲击留下的低库存痕迹难以抹去，并可在油价下方形成更高的支撑。原油对应的是 WTI 结算价 99.90 和布伦特结算价 113.88。若谈判破裂且布伦特重新升破 113.88，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: WTI at 99.90 and Brent at 113.88 as Gulf cooling extended the drop.
trigger.zh: 海湾降温把跌势延长，WTI 为 99.90，布伦特为 113.88。

invalidator.en: The talks break and Brent rises back through 113.88.
invalidator.zh: 谈判破裂，且布伦特重新升破 113.88。

title.en: The Treasury curve flattened again and the 10-year stayed under 5%
title.zh: 国债曲线再度走平，10年期收益率仍低于 5%

fact.en: The 10-year yield fell 0.41 basis points to 4.9843%, the 2-year rose 1.27 basis points to 4.7286%, and the 30-year fell 0.53 basis points to 5.2975%, 华尔街见闻 reported. The curve flattened after the 5-year auction, with limited moves ahead of the Fed decision, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：10年期收益率跌0.41个基点报4.9843%，2年期涨1.27个基点报4.7286%，30年期跌0.53个基点报5.2975%。 财经早茶：5年期国债标售后收益率曲线走平，美联储宣布利率决议前夕市场波动有限。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: The curve flattened because the two-year yield rose and the thirty-year yield fell, while the ten-year yield stayed under 5%. CICC (24 October): in their October investor survey, haven assets were still the main allocation, and a larger share of respondents wanted to extend duration. Treasuries carry the 4.9843% ten-year yield and the 4.7286% two-year yield. The theme changes if the ten-year yield closes at 5% or higher.
mechanism.zh: 曲线走平，是因为 2 年期收益率上升、30 年期收益率下降，而 10 年期收益率仍低于 5%。中金（10月24日）：在其 10 月投资者调查中，避险资产仍是主要配置，倾向于延长久期的受访者占比上升。美债对应的是 10 年期收益率 4.9843% 和 2 年期收益率 4.7286%。若 10 年期收益率收于 5% 或更高，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: A 10-year yield of 4.9843% that stayed under 5%, with the 2-year at 4.7286%, after the 5-year auction.
trigger.zh: 5 年期国债标售之后，10 年期收益率为 4.9843%，仍低于 5%，2 年期为 4.7286%。

invalidator.en: The 10-year yield closes at 5% or higher.
invalidator.zh: 10 年期收益率收于 5% 或更高。

title.en: A second equity up day landed on a heavily subscribed AI share sale
title.zh: 美股连续第二个交易日上涨，人工智能股票发行获得高倍认购

fact.en: The S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7722.60 and the Nasdaq rose 1.18% to 26477.81, 华尔街见闻 reported. Meta's 250亿美元 share sale drew five times demand, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：标普500涨0.60%报7722.60点，纳指涨1.18%报26477.81点。 财经早茶：Meta的250亿美元股票发行交易据悉获得五倍认购。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: A second up day landed on a share sale that found five times the demand, so the financing for this build got larger. CICC (22 September): overseas AI capital spending is still growing, but the pace may slow from the fourth quarter. US equities carry the 0.60% S&P 500 rise to 7722.60 and the 1.18% Nasdaq rise to 26477.81. The theme changes if that share sale is pulled or those two indexes give back this rise.
mechanism.zh: 第二个上涨日伴随一笔获得五倍认购的股票发行，相关建设融资的规模因此扩大。中金（9月22日）：海外人工智能资本开支仍在增长，但增速或自四季度放缓。美股对应的是标普500上涨 0.60% 至 7722.60，以及纳斯达克上涨 1.18% 至 26477.81。若该发行被撤回，或这两个指数回吐这一涨幅，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: The S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7722.60 and the Nasdaq rose 1.18% to 26477.81 as a 250亿美元 share sale drew five times demand.
trigger.zh: 标普500上涨 0.60% 至 7722.60，纳斯达克上涨 1.18% 至 26477.81，同时一笔 250亿美元 的股票发行获得五倍认购。

invalidator.en: The share sale is pulled or the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq give back this rise.
invalidator.zh: 股票发行被撤回，或标普500与纳斯达克回吐这一涨幅。

title.en: Shanghai gave back Monday's hold and ChiNext fell again
title.zh: 上证未能守住周一的企稳，创业板再度下跌

fact.en: The Shanghai Composite fell 1.33% to 3648.30, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.50% to 11245.73, and ChiNext fell 3.41% to 2548.15, 华尔街见闻 reported.

mechanism.en: The small Shanghai hold did not last a second session, and the growth board fell harder than the benchmark. CICC (19 October): in the latest choppy stretch, the broad equity ETFs they track saw net inflows pick up again. A-shares carry the 1.33% drop to 3648.30 and the 3.41% ChiNext drop to 2548.15. The old hold is finished unless Shanghai closes back above 3648.30 and ChiNext rises.
mechanism.zh: 上证的企稳未能延续至第二个交易日，成长板块跌幅大于基准指数。中金（10月19日）：在最近这一段震荡里，其跟踪的宽基股票 ETF 净流入再度加快。A股对应的是上证下跌 1.33% 至 3648.30，以及创业板下跌 3.41% 至 2548.15。除非上证重新收在 3648.30 之上且创业板上涨，否则原先的企稳已经结束。

trigger.en: Shanghai fell 1.33% to 3648.30 and ChiNext fell 3.41% to 2548.15.

invalidator.en: Shanghai closes back above 3648.30 and ChiNext rises.
invalidator.zh: 上证重新收在 3648.30 之上，且创业板上涨。

title.en: Spot gold bounced back through 4000 while yields barely moved
title.zh: 收益率几乎未动，现货黄金反弹重新站上 4000

fact.en: Spot gold rose 1.09% to 4060.55 dollars and moved back through 4000, 华尔街见闻 reported. Dip-buying lifted gold, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：现货黄金涨1.09%报4060.55美元，重新站上4000美元。 财经早茶：逢低买盘推动黄金反弹。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: Gold rose on a day yields barely moved and equities rose, so this bounce stands apart from the Treasury tape. Morgan Stanley (28 October): gold has failed as a hedge in sharp equity selloffs since 2020, while it has cushioned violent Treasury selloffs, and the bank still prefers gold among metals. Gold carries the 1.09% rise in the spot price to 4060.55. The theme changes if that dip-buying reverses.
mechanism.zh: 黄金上涨的这一天，收益率几乎未动，股市也在上涨，因此这轮反弹与美债行情相互独立。摩根士丹利（10月28日）：自 2020 年以来，黄金在股市急跌中没有起到对冲作用，但在美债剧烈抛售中提供了缓冲；该行在金属中仍偏好黄金。黄金对应的是现货价格上涨 1.09% 至 4060.55。若这轮逢低买盘逆转，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: Spot gold rose 1.09% to 4060.55 and moved back through 4000.

title.en: The cash premium in copper jumped to a two-month high
title.zh: 铜的现货升水升至两个月高位

fact.en: LME copper rose 147 dollars to 14,474 dollars a tonne, and the cash premium over three-month copper rose to 206 dollars a tonne, 华尔街见闻 reported. That premium is the highest in two months and near-term supply is tighter, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME期铜涨147美元，报14,474美元/吨，现货较三个月期铜的溢价升至每吨206美元。 财经早茶：伦敦现货铜较期铜的溢价飙升至两个月来最高水平，显示短期供应压力加剧。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: The cash contract's premium over three-month copper is a shortage of metal now, which is a different force from the gold bounce. CICC (13 October): mine supply growth over the next few years still struggles to match demand, and the tight balance has not changed. Copper carries the 14,474 dollar LME price and the 206 dollar cash premium. The theme changes if that cash premium falls back and the backwardation disappears.
mechanism.zh: 现货合约相对三个月期铜的升水，反映的是当前金属短缺，与黄金反弹并非同一力量。中金（10月13日）：未来数年矿山供应的增长仍难跟上需求，紧平衡没有改变。铜对应的是伦铜价格 14,474 美元和现货升水 206 美元。若该升水回落、期货贴水结构消失，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: LME copper at 14,474 dollars a tonne, with the cash premium at 206 dollars, the highest in two months.
trigger.zh: 伦铜报每吨 14,474 美元，现货升水 206 美元，为两个月高位。

invalidator.en: The cash premium over three-month copper falls back from 206 dollars.
invalidator.zh: 相对三个月期铜的现货升水自 206 美元回落。

title.en: French consumer sentiment fell to a 13-year low
title.zh: 法国消费者信心降至 13 年低点

fact.en: The bond selloff and the unrest pulled French consumer confidence in October down to a 13-year low, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：受债券抛售潮及社会动荡冲击，法国10月消费者信心指数降至13年低点。

factSources.label: 彭博财经早茶 · 博索纳罗逃离巴西；东山精密港股上市 · 2026-10-28

mechanism.en: A 13-year low in the confidence index is the household side of the bond selloff and the unrest. CICC (12 October): the concessions required to pass the budget can limit how far the premium comes back. OATs do not get a fresh yield on this tape, so the exposure is the confidence index itself. The theme changes if the index turns up from this low or a named budget deal passes.
mechanism.zh: 信心指数降至 13 年低点，对应债券抛售与社会动荡在居民部门的表现。中金（10月12日）：为通过预算所需的让步，会限制溢价能收回多少。本期行情没有给出法国国债的新收益率，敞口就是信心指数本身。若该指数自这一低点回升，或一项已具名的预算协议获得通过，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: French consumer confidence at a 13-year low on the October print.
trigger.zh: 10月读数显示，法国消费者信心处于 13 年低点。

invalidator.en: The index turns up from this low, or a named budget deal passes.
invalidator.zh: 该指数自这一低点回升，或一项已具名的预算协议获得通过。

title.en: Japan's core inflation gauge accelerated to 3.2%
title.zh: 日本核心通胀指标加速至 3.2%

fact.en: The September consumer-price index excluding fresh food and special factors rose 3.2% from a year earlier, after 2.6% in August, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：剔除生鲜食品及特殊因素后的9月消费者价格同比上涨3.2%，8月为2.6%。

mechanism.en: A 3.2% core reading, up from 2.6%, is faster inflation than the prior month, and the hike path is the rates question under it. CICC (17 June): the bank raised its policy rate at that meeting and said further hikes were still ahead. The yen does not get a separate settle on this tape, so the exposure is that inflation print. The theme changes if the core measure is revised back to 2.6% or lower.
mechanism.zh: 核心读数 3.2%，高于前值 2.6%，通胀快于上月，对应的利率问题是加息路径。中金（6月17日）：日本银行在那次会议上上调政策利率，并表示进一步加息仍在前面。本期行情没有单独的日元结算价，敞口就是这一通胀读数。若该核心指标被下修至 2.6% 或更低，这一判断不再成立。

trigger.en: The BOJ-style core index at 3.2% in September, up from 2.6%.
trigger.zh: 9月日本银行口径的核心指数为 3.2%，前值为 2.6%。

invalidator.en: That core measure is revised back to 2.6% or lower.
invalidator.zh: 该核心指标被下修至 2.6% 或更低。

The chart is French consumer sentiment at a 13-year low.

text.zh: 财新：中共二十届五中全会10月26日上午在北京开始举行，会期至10月29日。讨论稿是关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党。

sources.label: 财新 10月26日五中全会

text.en: If the plenum text stays on party discipline, the profit print does not hand growth boards a stimulus bid.
text.zh: 若全会文本仍落在党的纪律上，利润数据不会为成长板块带来刺激行情。

text.en: If the overnight reverse repo stays this large beside a 7-day operation at 1.40%, the stance is still ample liquidity.
text.zh: 若隔夜逆回购维持这一规模，并与 1.40% 的 7 天期操作并列，立场仍是流动性充裕。

text.en: If ChiNext stays down while industrial profits are up 14.4%, the profit print and the equity tape are two different stories.
text.zh: 若创业板继续下跌而工业企业利润增长 14.4%，利润数据和股市行情并非同一条线索。

chinaDivergences.en: Industrial profits rose 14.4% and ChiNext fell 3.41%. Banks rose on the breakfast tape while the growth boards fell. The onshore yuan was 6.6670 at 03:00 Beijing on that tape, and a 28 October fix was not on 第一财经. The plenum draft is about party discipline while the PBOC's latest operation is a large overnight liquidity add.
chinaDivergences.zh: 工业企业利润增长 14.4%，创业板下跌 3.41%。早茶行情里银行上涨，成长板块下跌。该行情中北京时间 03:00 的在岸人民币为 6.6670，第一财经上没有 10月28日的中间价。全会讨论稿关于党的纪律，而央行最近一次操作是大规模隔夜流动性投放。

note.en: Briefing day through next Friday (6 November). Mainland China only on China rows. 2pm ET is 02:00 Beijing the next day. The FOMC decision after the 27-28 October meeting is 02:00 Beijing on 29 October and sits inside this window.
note.zh: 自简报日至下周五（11月6日）。中国一行只列中国内地。美东时间下午 2 点是次日北京时间 02:00。10月27日至28日会议之后的联邦公开市场委员会决定在 10月29日北京时间 02:00，落在本窗口内。

sources.en: Mail tape is the 28 October 财经早茶. US index and oil closes in the summary are 华尔街见闻 and CNBC. Yields, gold, and A-share and Hong Kong closes are 华尔街见闻. Industrial profits are 财新. The 27 October reverse repo is 第一财经. The plenum is 财新. Bitcoin's cross of $80,000 and the Binance Brazil filing are 律动. CICC desk views are on the matching themes. Central-bank dates are the Fed, ECB, and Bank of Japan calendars.
sources.zh: 邮件底稿是 10月28日财经早茶。摘要中的美股指数和原油收盘来自华尔街见闻和 CNBC。收益率、黄金以及 A 股和香港收盘来自华尔街见闻。工业企业利润来自财新。10月27日逆回购来自第一财经。全会来自财新。比特币越过 $80,000 以及币安的巴西申请来自律动。中金的研究观点写在对应主题上。央行日期来自美联储、欧洲央行和日本银行的日历。

singleSource.en: Bitcoin prints were not merged: the mail header was 63633.26, the breakfast was 80753.50, the 律动 flash was an intraday cross of $80,000 with a 0.10% 24-hour change and is not a close, and the dashboard CoinGecko quote is 80568. The dashboard Treasury curve prints the 10-year at 4.99 and the 2-year at 4.70; 华尔街见闻 prints 4.9843% and 4.7286%. Dashboard Brent futures at 110.60 are an intraday futures quote, not the 113.88 settle. Dashboard gold futures at 4071.20 are an intraday futures quote, not spot 4060.55. Onshore yuan at 03:00 Beijing was 6.6670; the dashboard USD/CNY is 6.6558 and is not that fix. 第一财经 has no 28 October yuan fix; the operation cited is 27 October.
singleSource.zh: 比特币报价未合并：邮件页眉为 63633.26，早茶为 80753.50，律动快讯为盘中越过 $80,000、24 小时变动 0.10%，并非收盘价，看板中 CoinGecko 报价为 80568。看板国债曲线将 10 年期记为 4.99、2 年期记为 4.70，华尔街见闻则为 4.9843% 与 4.7286%。看板布伦特期货 110.60 是期货盘中报价，不是 113.88 的结算价。看板黄金期货 4071.20 是期货盘中报价，不是现货 4060.55。北京时间 03:00 的在岸人民币为 6.6670；看板美元/人民币为 6.6558，并非该中间价。第一财经没有 10月28日的人民币中间价；所引操作为 10月27日。

caveats: Event Calendar mainland China only on China rows. Equity, yield, oil, and bitcoin rows in Market closes are the inject snapshot. note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。
